metadata.case_name: CHEUNG KWOK KEUNG v. YIP MAN HING BUILDING MATERIALS CO LTD AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: self-employed as a delivery worker with his van
plaintiff.occupation_after: self-employed van driver and delivery worker (part-time)

injuries.description: Garden type IV, comminuted fracture of the right neck of femur
source: The diagnosis was traumatic fracture of right hip (neck of femur) after X-ray of pelvis. It was a Garden type IV comminuted fracture.

injuries.description: Avascular Necrosis (AVN) of right hip, Ficat type III with articular collapse and early ostoarthropathy
source: On 9 November 2009, Cheung complained about increased hip pain. An X-ray examination disclosed features of Avascular Necrosis (“AVN”) of right hip and no cut-out of screws was noted.
A MRI examination was performed in July 2010 and it showed right femoral head AVN with articular collapse and early ostoarthropathy.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

treatments_received: closed reduction and screw fixation on 6 February 2007
second closed reduction and internal fixation on 9 February 2007
operation for removal of screws and hip arthroscopy on 3 December 2010
physiotherapy (24 treatment sessions at the Physiotherapy Department of UCH between 13 March 2007 and 25 October 2007)
Chinese medical treatments with acupuncture (about 24 times)
private orthopaedic consultations (Dr. Yeung Kong Fan once and Dr. Chan Sai Keung once)

losses.description: limited walking pace; difficulty going upstairs

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks

comparable_cases.case_name: Tai Mei Lin v. Fung King Kong
